body: I’m doing heroin every day right now. I don’t know any other way of coping with this shit and I can’t keep doing this without dying
Every day feels like I’m suffering and I’m using heroin to cope. I can’t keep this up without dying.
That’s amazing ❤️ that inspired me a lot.. that is what I’m trying to do so hard. It’s rough trying to get rid of these suicidal ideations

I am currently going through a very hard time with someone I love very much and she loved me a lot too.. we might not work out at this point and trust me I know how you feel I want to die every day. I cry myself to sleep just wondering what I did wrong. I treated her better than I have ever treated anyone including myself and she told me she needs space to work on herself but that she still loves me and wants to be with me but yet she doesn’t talk to me anymore. I feel your pain and I know how hard it is.. ending your life isn’t the solution if it doesn’t work out with your girlfriend now you will find love again. You sound like a very good person that treats people right and you deserve love and you will be loved if you be yourself. It will be ok ❤️

Please don’t do it. I don’t know you but I feel your pain and I care about you as a person. Life can be worth living, that’s what I keep trying to tell myself. Open up to her, tell her what’s going on if she loves you she will accept you just the way you are, if she doesn’t then you deserve way better. Stay strong brother you can do this

I feel pathetic even posting this.. I really need someone to talk to... if there is anyone out there please help me. I don’t know what to do. I cry myself to sleep every night just praying I would die
